sections.title: More than one thing you’d like to change?
sections.sub: A smile makeover may suit you if there’s more than one thing about your smile you’d like to change. If only one thing bothers you, a single treatment may be all you need, and we’ll tell you so.
items: Discoloured or stained teeth
Coffee, tea and time have taken the brightness out of your smile.
Chipped, worn or uneven teeth
Edges that have lost their shape over the years.
Gaps between teeth
Spacing you’d like closed or evened out.
Crooked or crowded teeth
One or two teeth sitting out of line.
You want it done in the right order
Straightening, whitening and bonding planned to work together.
You want to know the full cost
Every stage priced in writing before you commit.
sections.close: Your teeth and gums need to be healthy first, so if we find decay or gum disease, we treat that first and include it in your plan.

sections.title: Clear prices, stage by stage.
sections.sub: The cost depends on which treatments are in your plan and how many teeth are involved. You see the full cost in writing before treatment begins.

sections.name: What is a smile makeover
sections.title: Two or more treatments, working together.
sections.text: A smile makeover combines two or more cosmetic treatments, carried out in a planned order, to change the look of your smile.

card.title: As simple, or as complete, as you need
card.text: It might be as simple as whitening followed by bonding on a couple of front teeth, or a longer plan that starts with straightening. Every plan is bespoke, and we recommend only what suits your smile.

items: How many treatments make a smile makeover?
Usually two or more, chosen to work together. We recommend only what suits your smile, so your plan might be shorter than you expect.
Why does the order of treatment matter?
Straightening first means bonding or veneers fit your teeth in their final position, and whitening first means your new work can be matched to your whitened shade.
Can I have treatment in stages?
Yes. Because your plan is set out in stages, you can start with one treatment and continue when you are ready. We will tell you if any stage needs to follow on from another.
Do I need a consultation first?
Yes. We need to see your teeth and gums and hear what you would like to change before we can plan treatment. Invisalign and whitening consultations are free.
How long does a smile makeover take?
It depends on the treatments you choose. A plan that includes straightening takes longer than one based on whitening and bonding. We set out the timeline in your written plan.
